title: Dashboard statistics
interface: class DashboardService(assets: AssetRepository, handovers: HandoverRepository, audit: AuditRepository, employees: EmployeeRepository). stats(today: str, warranty_days: int = 90) -> dict: 'totals' {'assets': count of all assets, 'value': sum of price as float, 'employees': count of active employees}; 'by_status' (assets.count_by('status')); 'by_type' (count_by('type')); 'by_condition'; 'pending_handovers': handovers.list_all(status='pending') each with 'asset' (assets.get) and 'employee' (employees.get); 'warranty_expiring': assets.search_assets(warranty_before=today + warranty_days (date arithmetic, ISO)) excluding retired/lost, sorted by warranty_until; 'recent_activity': audit.list_recent(20). Never catch generic Exception.
